title: A pathwise Ito formula for weakly differentiable functions
summary: We prove a version of Föllmer's pathwise Itô formula for weakly differentiable functions of continuous paths with finite quadratic variation along a sequence of partitions. For each such path $ω$, we introduce a path-dependent Sobolev space $W_{ω,π}^{2}$ defined through smooth approximation of the weak Hessian in a seminorm generated by discrete weighted occupation measures of the path $ω$.
